source: Phase 0 platform acceptance: Real desktop E2E → OTLP → Beijing ARMS/SLS, followed by read-only query verification
scope: This document only records platform-side acceptance; see local-ttft-evidence.json and local-ttft-diagnostics-evidence.json for local OTLP egress evidence.

endpointProbe.note: Ingestion values are taken from CI variables CF_PACKAGED_AGENT_OTEL_ENDPOINT/_HEADERS, secrets are not stored; the table below only records path formats and status codes.

results.meaning: Existing concatenation on Trace side is usable
Metric-side base+/v1/metrics concatenation is usable; previously suspected path incompatibility risks do not apply
SLS 不使用独立 metric base

endpointProbe.conclusion: The same OTLP base receives both traces and metrics; desktop main does not need an independent metrics endpoint injection channel.

transport.mode: E2E runtime injects OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT via env pointing to local receiver, which forwards raw body/encoding verbatim to the real endpoint.
transport.caveat: Forwarded bytes match direct exporter connections, but the compilation injection write path for packaged builds launched from Finder/Start Menu remains unverified (Phase 1)

singleMessageWaterfall.reconciliation: Union of the six main stages at 701.69ms reconciles with the root at 701.70ms, consistent with unattributed_ms=0 for this sample.

metricAcceptance.nameMapping: OTel → Prometheus does not append unit suffixes; default cf_local_ttft_* names in local-ttft-queries.md hold true.
metricAcceptance.deltaTemporality: sum_over_time accumulates interval samples as expected; rate/increase are not used

queries.name: 阶段样本 count
queries.note: First stages run: 3 sends × 6 stages, no attempt amplification

queries.name: Total P50
queries.note: Bucket interpolation, not exact raw percentile

queries.name: attempt by role/outcome
queries.note: Failed retry attempts and first-output attempts are counted separately; main TTFT is not amplified.

metricAcceptance.droppedCounter: No cf.local_ttft.dropped series observed this run, meaning no capacity/queue drops.

ingestionLatency.method: Polled at 5-second intervals starting immediately after the second stages run ended until new samples were queryable.
ingestionLatency.interpretation: Both details and aggregations were queryable upon E2E completion (hit on first poll, upper bound <5s), outperforming the target of seconds-to-tens-of-seconds for details and ~5 minutes for aggregations; this is not an exact per-item measurement from generation to visibility.

notVerified: Visual confirmation of waterfall rendering and navigation in ARMS/Trace Explorer console (this run checked data integrity entirely via read-only APIs)
Compilation injection write path for packaged builds launched from Finder/Start Menu (Phase 1)
7-day detail / 30-day aggregate retention, capacity, and actual costs (Phase 3)
End-to-end effect of canary rollout delivered via server-side client configs (Phase 2)

sideEffects.productionWrites: Wrote controlled samples from 12 sends to production telemetry database this run
sideEffects.identification: 识别并排除；这些Tags不会出现在真实User样本Medium
sideEffects.cleanup: Both metrics and traces expire naturally according to retention periods, without manual deletion.
